what: When the strip of square cells comes within 160px of the bottom of the screen, each cell flickers 2 to 4 times (.045~.09s apart) and then stays lit. The farther a cell is from the origin (bottom and top), the later it starts, up to .28s. After all are lit, cells within 96 of the mouse flicker once or twice (the same cell rests .16s), and on touch, two rounds ripple out from the tapped spot

options.origin: ”bottom” (default) lights up from the bottom cell, ”top” from the top cell
options.enter: Reveal time multiplier, default 1 — at 2 it is twice as slow (hero side cells)
options.radius: Cursor radius, default 96 — in viewBox units for svg
options.cooldown: Time before the same slot flickers again (ms), default 160
options.flashes: Cursor blink count, default 0 (random once or twice)
options.listen: ”parent” makes it blink even when moving over the parent (decoration on both sides of the title)

use: <svg data-fx="pixel-flicker" data-fx-pixel-flicker="origin: top" viewBox="0 0 1760 240" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><g fill="currentColor"><rect x="0" y="0" width="41" height="41"/>…</g></svg> — In svg, each rect is a cell. In html, each child element is a cell
note: Cell color is painted by the consumer with currentColor — using the next section’s background color so the backdrop and next section blend gives the original band

from.where: shared.js SY.pixels — section-boundary pixel strip (40px cells, 1760×240 four sets) · index.js hero side cells (65px · enter: 2 · radius: 280 · cooldown: 240 · pace: 4 · flashes: 1 · listen: parent)
